description: Read the latest successful PDF for an explicit entry .tex path, or check the exact job returned by compile_pdf using jobId. Returns a private link valid for at most 10 minutes, progress and fingerprint-based freshness against server-saved files and compiler settings. This never compiles, waits, or polls internally. If a current PDF is needed and the result is missing, outdated or unknown, use compile_pdf then read_pdf with its jobId. For queued/running jobs respect retryAfterSeconds and check at most 5 times per user request; report pending instead of polling indefinitely. If saved inputs changed during compilation, report it rather than repeatedly recompiling. Download and open the PDF before discussing its contents or layout; say if your client cannot inspect PDFs. Unsaved browser edits are not included. Use read_file for uploaded PDF assets.

jobId.description: Optional compile_pdf job ID. Checks only this job and never falls back to another PDF.

path.description: Project-relative entry .tex path, such as main.tex. Not a PDF path or URL.

name: read_pdf
title: Read an existing compiled PDF
